sources.quote: Zhu Xi was born in Youqi in Fujian in October 1130
By far the most influential Neo-Confucian philosopher is Zhu Xi (1130–1200)
Zhu Xi was born in Youqi in Fujian province, China in 1130

claims.text: summary: Tổng hợp Tân Nho giáo: lý và khí, cách vật trí tri

sources.quote: created the supreme synthesis of Song-Ming dynasty (960-1628 CE) Neo-Confucianism
He drew upon received notions of li (pattern) and qi (cosmic vapor)
Zhu Xi advocates conducting the “investigation of things to attain/extend knowledge”

claims.text: summary: chú giải Tứ thư làm chuẩn khoa cử từ năm 1313

sources.quote: His interpretation of the Confucian canon became the basis of the civil service examination in 1313
Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) officialdom adopted Zhu Xi’s edition of the Four Books as the basis for the Imperial Examination System

notes: Kiểm lại 5.1b: cạnh influence chu-hy → chu-van-an (claim chua-kiem-duoc cũ) đã bị bỏ khỏi bản ghi (influence: []), nên bỏ claim đó. Các trường còn lại không đổi; claim cũ giữ nguyên. Mốc 1313 lấy từ SEP song-ming-confucianism; SEP zhu-xi chỉ nói 'a century later, Yuan dynasty'.
